mapper.sql: id, email, lang, status, confirm_token, confirm_sent_at, confirm_sends, unsub_token, src, cmp, ref, start_param, created_at, confirmed_at, notified_at, unsubscribed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO growth_waitlist (email, lang, status, confirm_token, confirm_sent_at, confirm_sends, unsub_token, src, cmp, ref, start_param, ip_hash, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{lang}, 'PENDING', #{confirmToken}, #{now}, 1, #{unsubToken}, #{src}, #{cmp}, #{ref}, #{start}, #{ipHash}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_waitlist SET confirm_sent_at = #{now}, confirm_sends = confirm_sends + 1, lang = #{lang}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND confirm_sends = #{sends}
UPDATE growth_waitlist SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE growth_waitlist SET status = 'UNSUBSCRIBED', unsubscribed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'NOTIFIED')
UPDATE growth_waitlist SET status = 'NOTIFIED', notified_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM growth_waitlist WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM growth_waitlist WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT status, admin_id, reason, recipients, sent, created_at, finished_at FROM growth_launch WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO growth_launch (id, status, admin_id, reason, recipients, sent, created_at) VALUES (1, 'SENDING', #{adminId}, #{reason}, #{recipients}, 0, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_launch SET sent = sent + #{n} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE growth_launch SET status = 'DONE', finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = 1 AND status = 'SENDING'
